name: EMPIRE 4WAVE 1200W diode laser

description: EMPIRE 4WAVE is a new-generation professional diode laser hair removal system: 1200W output power, four wavelengths and intelligent treatment support in a single device.

videoDescription.headline: EMPIRE 4WAVE – not simply more powerful, but smarter
paragraphs: EMPIRE 4WAVE combines high 1200W output power, the combined use of four wavelengths and modern treatment-support functions in a single device.

The Android-based interface keeps digital client records, treatment history and before–after photos in one profile, while the micro-camera diagnostic head provides magnified hair and skin analysis – and the system recommends treatment parameters based on these.

featureRows.headline: Why choose EMPIRE?
featureRows.subtitle: 1200W power, 4 wavelengths, micro-camera diagnostics and digital client records – a smarter system for professional hair removal.

features.title: 4WAVE technology – four wavelengths in one device
features.description: 755 nm supports the treatment of finer hairs richer in melanin, 808 nm is the classic, versatile wavelength of diode laser hair removal, 940 nm further broadens the treatment spectrum, and 1064 nm offers deeper penetration – an important element of a treatment strategy tailored to skin type. The system's scope of application is Fitzpatrick skin types I–VI.

features.title: Micro-camera hair and skin diagnostics
features.description: The separate diagnostic head, with its own LED illumination, provides magnified hair and skin analysis and digital photo capture. You don't have to determine the treatment parameters from memory: the system recommends settings based on skin type, body area, mode and treatment area.
features.highlight: You see what you are treating – and you document it too.

features.title: Digital client records
features.description: Treatment history and before–after photos stored in one client profile, directly on the device. Every time, you can see which parameters you worked with last time, and the client's results can be tracked.

features.title: 3 professional treatment modes
features.description: SHR STACK (4–45 J, 2–5 pulses): stacked pulses determined automatically based on the client's sex, body area and skin type. SHR (4–100 J, 1–20 Hz): optimised pulse energy, frequency and total energy based on the treatment area. HR (4–100 J, 1–20 Hz): traditional spot-by-spot treatment.

features.title: Comprehensive cooling and safety system
features.description: Water and air cooling, semiconductor skin cooling with a sapphire contact surface. Key start, emergency stop, interlock, protection against cooling failure, overheating and low water flow, plus overload and short-circuit protection. The device continuously monitors water temperature and flow, and automatically stops laser emission in the event of an abnormality.
features.highlight: An automatic self-check runs at power-on.

training.headline: Operator training – part of the purchase
training.intro: The price of the EMPIRE device includes comprehensive operator training. You will learn how to use the three treatment modes, the micro-camera diagnostics and the digital client records.

faq.question: How is EMPIRE different from our other diode lasers?
faq.answer: Besides power, EMPIRE is built around treatment support: micro-camera hair and skin diagnostics, digital client records with before–after photos, and parameters recommended based on skin type, body area, mode and treatment area – all on an Android-based interface.

faq.question: What can the micro-camera diagnostic head do?
faq.answer: With its own LED illumination it performs magnified hair and skin analysis and captures photos digitally. The images are saved to the client's digital record, so treatments can be documented before and after.

faq.question: What is the difference between SHR STACK, SHR and HR modes?
faq.answer: SHR STACK (4–45 J, 2–5 pulses): stacked pulses, determined automatically based on the client's sex, body area and skin type. SHR (4–100 J, 1–20 Hz): optimised individual pulse energy and frequency based on the treatment area. HR (4–100 J, 1–20 Hz): traditional spot-by-spot treatment.

faq.question: Which skin types can it be used on?
faq.answer: The system's scope of application is Fitzpatrick skin types I–VI. Parameters must always be determined based on the current skin condition and the treatment area – the parameter recommendations and the operator training both help with this.

faq.question: How many spot sizes does it work with?
faq.answer: 3 interchangeable spot sizes. The treatment area can be set to 25, 50, 100 or 300 cm², and the laser pulse can be fired with the handpiece switch or a foot switch.

faq.question: What maintenance does it require?
faq.answer: According to the manufacturer's recommendation: energy calibration every 12 months, cooling water and filter replacement every 2–3 months, cleaning the device weekly, cleaning the light-emitting surface before and after every treatment, and software updates as needed.

faq.question: What conditions are required for operation?
faq.answer: A temperature of 15–30 °C, a maximum relative humidity of 80%, an air pressure of 860–1060 hPa, and at least 60 cm of free space around the device.

faq.question: Can EMPIRE be bought in instalments?
faq.answer: Yes. With a 50% deposit, and the remaining amount spread over 3, 6 or 12 months – we agree the exact terms during a consultation. You can use the calculator on this page to work out the monthly instalment in advance.
